token_order: First sample/CFG branch only. Flatten token or patch dimensions inside that sample, retaining original tensor shape; do not concatenate batch or CFG branches into the token axis.
raw_data: Signed unpooled activation windows with all channels, actual input/output shapes, stage/step/call IDs, token row IDs; signed exact weight windows and equivalent full-precision weight windows; transforms and source checkpoint identities. Transform full channel dimension before cropping. Clamp windows to actual dimensions; never pool, stride or reorder channels.
query_budget_scope: 10 data-capture queries. Compare saved same-arm actions when available; explicitly record an absent native reference rather than adding another forward or comparing against decoded-BF16 execution.
context_scope: Two known frozen observation cases and one saved sampler seed each; descriptive mechanism visualization, not a new accuracy benchmark.
plot_scope: Shared linear heights and shared colors within each layer comparison; activation height is absolute value. Paired-local and actual end-to-end views remain distinct. Weight axes are output channel and input channel. VQ executes decoded BF16; native arms retain native INT4 execution. Raw signed values remain available independently of figures.
